g_policy.reason: The button is opt-in, offer copy 'Play a short game to get 1 life now' states the reward, declining changes nothing, and the button is hidden or no life is given if the game fails.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 1 in-game life, which cannot be withdrawn or exchanged.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is an app event: tapping Play with 0 lives opens the pop-up. No chat content is involved.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The idea removes and caps nothing that is free today; the 3-a-day cap applies only to the new offer and the existing life timer is unchanged.

g_brand_safety.reason: The placement is a button inside the s02 modal, which is rated safe and sits over a non-chat screen (s01, safe).

c1_revealed_value.reason: The app limits lives (m01: 5 max, 30-minute regen) and sells them for gold bars (m02, l02), so the reward gives a resource the app charges for and limits.

c2_evidence.reason: Claims about 5 lives, the 30-minute regen, and the gold-bar button rest on m01, m02, s02.e02 and s02.e03, and the 'no subscription' claim matches m02. Claims about the new button, cap and copy are the proposal's own additions.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward is 1 life, capped at 3 a day, so it doesn't give away a full set of lives, and it takes nothing from other users. The life is consumed on use and the gold-bar sale for full sets stays intact.

c5_moment.reason: The offer appears in the out-of-lives pop-up right after the player hits the limit, which is a moment of need.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It is a play-to-earn unit and the life is granted only if the game counts (verified play). The trigger, tapping Play with 0 lives, is a detectable app event.

c7_specific.reason: It names the s02 out-of-lives pop-up, the gold-bar button, the 5-life cap, and the 30-minute timer, which are specific to this app.

other_concern: The 'costs the game nothing to give' rationale is a revenue-adjacent assumption; the cost of a full set of lives in gold bars is unknown (open question), though it is not needed for any claim.
